## Fixes

- **The server no longer stops on a snippet.** Tools other than the scanners lexed files without their language's syntax: a JavaScript regexp holding a quote read as a string to the end of the file, a snippet range ran past its definition and the server panicked. Every reader of tokens now uses the scanner's configuration, and a range that does not fit the file is refused.
- **Names stay within their language.** A name used in one language no longer counts as a use of a definition in an unrelated one, so a JavaScript variable no longer reaches Rust tests.
- **A documentation heading is no class.** A struct sharing its name with a heading resolves its methods again.
- **Rust aliases and unit structs end at their semicolon** instead of taking the next item into their range and snippet.

## Tools

- `get_code_snippet` names the lines of other definitions of the same name in the file (`also_defined_at`) and takes `max_lines`, with the line it would go on at.

The snapshot format and the scanner identity changed; the first `analyse` after upgrading rebuilds the graph.

## Install

- Homebrew: `brew install attackwave/glasir/glasir`
- Scoop: add the bucket `Attackwave/scoop-glasir`, then run `scoop install glasir`
